components.label: api
responsibilities: Expose authoring use cases through one transport-neutral entry point.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own compilation, verification, or transport behavior.

components.label: domain
responsibilities: Own typed intent, rules, diagnostics, and pure acceptance facts.

components.label: projection
responsibilities: Project reference and schema views from canonical DSL and intent facts.
forbidden_responsibilities: Define a second DSL catalog or execute a run.

requires.rationale: Projections render authoring-owned facts and types.

components.label: adapters
responsibilities: Compile intent to XML and adapt bounded parse and run checks.
forbidden_responsibilities: Own intent or duplicate executable DSL definitions.

requires.rationale: Adapters consume typed intent and diagnostics.
Compiler and linter use derived DSL schema views.

components.label: application
responsibilities: Sequence lint, compilation, bounded verification, and declared acceptance.
forbidden_responsibilities: Define new grammar facts or directly execute Runtime internals.

requires.rationale: Workflows operate on typed authoring requests and results.
Workflows delegate compilation and bounded checks.

rules.rationale: Pure intent and rules must not depend on file or execution adapters.
